historyPolicy: Raw samples are retained for up to 3 days, 5-minute summaries up to 30 days, then hourly summaries until retention expires. Routine logs are retained for up to 7 days. Service and proxy health checks remain frequent.
title: Settings
description: Monitoring, alerts, data retention, and the activity report.
demoNote: Threshold changes affect health evaluation. Reset returns infrastructure data to the initial seed.
themeHint: The theme is changed from the top bar and is saved separately from this form.

streams.tunnelProbe: Tunnel ping, packet loss, and jitter

autoFailback: Automatically return DNS to the primary tunnel after packet loss falls below the threshold
failoverHint: If the active tunnel is offline, its packet loss reaches the threshold, or that server's agent stops reporting, the node's own domain is found in DNS and the backup server IP is placed on it.
telegramSimulated: The Telegram notification was only simulated
accessHint: The role is changed from the user menu in the top bar. User management applies only to the super administrator and does not create a real account in this preview.
securityHidden: The current role cannot view the security section or make structural changes.
superAdminAccess: The super administrator can reset all data and use every demo operation.
retentionHint: Reports use this value as the default range limit.

password.title: Change administrator password
password.hint: The new password must be at least 15 characters. Changing it signs out other sessions, and passkeys must be registered again.
password.mismatch: The confirmation does not match the new password.
password.failed: The password could not be changed.

telegram.title: Telegram notification delivery

errors.invalid_token: Invalid bot token. Check the token from BotFather.
errors.bot_forbidden: The bot cannot send messages. Check blocking and group permissions.
errors.invalid_chat: Check the destination ID and bot access. Start the bot before sending private messages.
errors.delivery_unconfirmed: Delivery was not confirmed. Check the server connection to Telegram.
errors.worker_interrupted: Delivery processing was interrupted; the outcome is unconfirmed.

telegram.queued: The message was queued for Telegram
telegram.enabled: The destination is configured on the server.
telegram.disabled: Telegram delivery is not enabled in the server settings.
telegram.testBody: A test message is sent to the configured destination and the result is shown.
telegram.empty: No delivery result has been recorded yet.

passkey.title: Fingerprint and passkey sign-in
passkey.body: Create a passkey on this device. The next sign-in uses the device fingerprint, face recognition, or configured PIN.
passkey.name: Passkey name
passkey.failed: The passkey could not be changed.

errors.failoverBusy: Another failover operation is already running.
errors.cooldown: The cooldown is still active. Wait another {seconds} seconds.
errors.tunnelPreflight: The demo tunnel deployment failed preflight.
errors.serverNotFound: The selected server was not found.
errors.dnsTarget: The DNS target was not found.

audit.tunnelDeleted: The tunnel was removed from the demo inventory
audit.tunnelCreated: The tunnel was created only in demo data
audit.speedtestDone: The test finished without using real bandwidth

workflows.dnsNote: The sample record changed to {ip}. A TTL of {ttl} seconds and open connections prevent clients from moving immediately.
workflows.portBusy: The port is occupied in this scenario.
workflows.noConflict: A similar running service does not block this scenario.
workflows.jobCreated: The demo job was created. No shell runs on the server.

failoverRun.started: The simulation started. No real service is changed.
failoverRun.rollbackCheck: Primary-path readiness for failback is being checked.
failoverRun.primaryStillOffline: The primary path is still offline.
failoverRun.rollbackBlocked: Failback did not run because the primary server or tunnel is not ready.
failoverRun.rollbackDns: Sample DNS returns to the primary IP address. The client cache may still show the standby.
failoverRun.rollbackDnsNote: DNS failback was simulated, and TTL can still delay users.
failoverRun.rollbackDone: The demo failback to the primary server completed.
failoverRun.v2bxStopped: The V2bX service on the foreign server stopped. The tunnel itself is not necessarily down.
failoverRun.standbySameForeign: The standby Iran server uses the same foreign server and does not bring V2bX up.
failoverRun.v2bxNotSolved: An Iran-path failover does not fix a stopped V2bX service. Start the service on the foreign server.
failoverRun.aRecordMismatch: The A record does not match the active IP address.
failoverRun.mismatchInjected: A mismatch was injected for the demo.
failoverRun.pathHealthyDnsOnly: The network path is healthy and only DNS is corrected.
failoverRun.authoritativeFixed: The authoritative record was corrected and resolver propagation is not complete yet.
failoverRun.dnsFixNote: The DNS correction is a demo and does not change the real public cache.
failoverRun.resolverSynced: The sample resolver converged. Clients with an old cache move later.
failoverRun.dnsMismatchFixed: The DNS mismatch was corrected in the demo.
failoverRun.pathProbed: The current path probe was recorded.
failoverRun.standbyRejected: The demo scenario rejected standby readiness.
failoverRun.standbyNotReady: The standby agent or tunnel is not ready.
failoverRun.switchSkipped: The switch was not performed, to avoid a complete outage.
failoverRun.standbyStopped: The standby is unavailable and failover stopped.
failoverRun.primaryTunnelDown: The primary tunnel went down. The host itself is not necessarily off.
failoverRun.primaryProbesFailing: Probes of the primary server are failing.
failoverRun.primaryOffline: The primary server went offline. Nodes that are still active on it also become unreachable.
failoverRun.standbyPathDown: The standby tunnel or server is not ready.
failoverRun.standbyCapacityOk: Standby capacity and the replacement tunnel were confirmed.
failoverRun.dnsSwitched: Sample DNS switched to the standby IP address. Open connections are not dropped immediately.
failoverRun.dnsSwitchNote: The demo DNS switch completed. TTL and open sessions can keep the user on the previous path for a while.
failoverRun.validationRollback: End-to-end verification failed and rollback started.
failoverRun.validationReverted: Recovery validation failed and the demo changes were reverted.
failoverRun.backupPathVerified: End-to-end connectivity through the standby path was confirmed.
failoverRun.backupStable: The standby path is stable. The stability window for automatic failback has started.
failoverRun.primaryReportedHealthy: The primary server is reported healthy again.
failoverRun.autoFailback: Automatic failback returned DNS to the primary server.
failoverRun.failbackNote: Demo failback completed. The DNS cache may still hold the standby IP address.
failoverRun.primaryServiceStable: The service is stable on the primary path.
failoverRun.autoRecoveryDone: The failure, switch, and automatic failback were simulated successfully.
failoverRun.demoComplete: The demo failover completed. Users with an open session may still see the previous path.
failoverRun.trafficMoved: Demo traffic for this node was moved to the standby server.

agent.title: Update NodeGuard Agent
agent.hint: Install the bundled Agent on enrolled servers while preserving configuration. Service installation and telemetry reporting are tracked separately.

virtualizor.help: Use the Enduser API credentials from your Virtualizor panel. Credentials are encrypted and never returned to the browser.
virtualizor.notConfigured: Configure Virtualizor in Settings → Integrations first.
virtualizor.storage: Set NODEGUARD_CREDENTIAL_KEY on the control plane to enable encrypted storage.
virtualizor.liveOnly: Virtualizor is available in monitoring mode.
virtualizor.bindingHelp: Enter the VPS ID from Virtualizor for this server. Check the returned hostname and IP before running commands.
virtualizor.accepted: Virtualizor accepted the command. Refresh status to check the result.
virtualizor.confirm: Run this command on Virtualizor VPS {id}? This can interrupt server connections.
